text.text_excerpt: This review is based on the Embassy Suites at The Lofts (across the street from the main hotel). I have never stayed at this extension of the Embassy Suites before. It was quaint and more of an intimate setting. The lobby & lounge was a lot smaller. As for the rooms, I loved the exposed brick and the huge storage space in the bedroom. I wasn't too crazy about the bathroom set-up. First of all, no bathtub, the door (when open) hit the shower glass and water leaked from the shower on the ground. 2nd, the couch (with pull-out bed) was kinda filthy. I did however enjoy the morning breakfast! It was perfect! Custom-made omelettes, fresh fruit, yogurt, bacon, sausage, juices, cereals (hot & col...

I was a bit skeptical about booking this place for my week stay as the reviews were pretty mixed but I couldn't be happier with my stay. I was given a room on the 12th floor which was awesome as it had dual balconies which overlook the city. Rooms were big and bed was comfortable and AC was perfectly cold. Breakfast was good as all embassy suites are and what really made my stay great was a personal text daily checking up on how my stay is going and if I need anything else to make my stay better. Location is also pretty great as its only a 5 minute walk to the convention center and 30 min walk to Bourbon Street. Overall this was definitely one of my better stays at a Hilton and would come...

This is one of the best hotels I've stayed at in a long time. The rooms are really nice and service is excellent. Also a great view of the city from your own personal patio. The beds are really comfortable and the pillows were soft yet firm enough for a good night's rest. They have free drinks from 5:30-7:30 which we took advantage of while we were there. The breakfast was really good too and they make omelettes to order for you. If you don't want omelets they have scrambled eggs and protein you can get buffet style. Staying here is worth every penny!! I enjoyed my stay and if I ever find myself in NOLA again, Embassy Suites will be my pick.
